measurement: Six events per role, with the interval recorded in its authoring reference (at least 1.2 seconds). Fixed original physical-palette gain and gameplay fades; never normalize against a previously generated candidate. Alternatives match their role reference, not other roles. Ice previews retain existing source levels.

groups.label: Footsteps
groups.description: Fresh tactile directions: a dry heel/toe contact or a light wooden patter.

groups.label: Mud
groups.description: Fresh granular and sticky textures, without the old low chord or soft brush.

groups.label: Wall contact
groups.description: Try an elastic rubber nudge or a dry fabric catch, not another hollow knock.

groups.label: Buildup
groups.description: Each warning lasts the actual 225 ms; compare it with the approved puff.

groups.label: Retry
groups.description: Falling feather is approved and used in the game. The other option remains unselected.

groups.label: Checkpoint
groups.description: Warm little arrival jingles: lower-register notes that settle into a welcoming harmony.

groups.label: Exit
groups.description: Short triumphant jingles: a clear rising phrase and a full resolving chord, not just a pad.

groups.label: Buttons
groups.description: Soft tick is approved and used in the game. The other option remains unselected.

groups.label: Ice
groups.description: Current movement cues and twelve existing musical directions. One finite source preview with fades; in-game movement filters may differ.
